item.title: BMW announces global vehicle recall
item.description: German automaker BMW has launched a global recall campaign affecting hundreds of thousands of vehicles due to a potential fire risk, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Kahramanmaraş rebuilds after earthquake of century
item.description: Three years have passed since the earthquakes centered in Kahramanmaraş on February 6, 2023, which deeply affected 11 provinces. Following this catastrophic disaster, described as the calamity of the century, the reconstruction and revitalization efforts initiated in Kahramanmaraş have now evolved into an almost epic story of transformation.

item.title: Georgia to restrict older car imports
item.description: The Georgian government has submitted to parliament a bill that would ban the import of passenger cars older than six years, Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze announced, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: China unveils Moon ship and reusable rocket
item.description: China’s space program, aiming to land astronauts on the Moon by 2030, conducted a test flight of a new reusable booster and crew capsule late Tuesday (US time), yielding spectacular results, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Risks and rewards of Azerbaijan’s leap into artificial intelligence
item.description: By presidential instruction, each ministry will appoint a deputy minister responsible for digitalization, innovation, and artificial intelligence, ensuring institutional accountability and direct coordination with the Ministry of Digital Development and Transport. The President also limited the creation of separate digital applications by ministries, requiring that services be delivered through the unified “MyGov” platform.

item.title: Singapore introduces AI-centered policies in 2026 budget
item.description: Singapore’s Prime Minister and Finance Minister, Lawrence Wong, on Thursday unveiled a series of measures in the 2026 financial year budget aimed at boosting artificial intelligence (AI), including business tax incentives, employee training programs, and free public access to advanced AI tools, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Azeri Light crude falls 3% at Augusta and Ceyhan Ports
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude declined in key export terminals, reflecting broader weakness across global oil markets.

item.title: SOCAR discusses joint energy projects with US companies and Israeli cooperation
item.description: President of the State Oil Company of the Republic of Azerbaijan (SOCAR), Rovshan Najaf, has met with a delegation led by Betsy Burns Korn, Chairwoman of the Conference of Presidents of Major American Jewish Organizations in the United States, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: UEFA Nations League: Azerbaijan's opponents determined
item.description: The draw for the 2026/2027 season of the UEFA Nations League has taken place in Brussels, Belgium, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Netherlands expands military capabilities ahead of possible large-scale conflict
item.description: The Netherlands is set to bolster its military capabilities in preparation for a potential large-scale conflict, the country’s Ministry of Defence announced.
